credentials.description: KadevPay secret key (Authorization: Bearer), server side only

parameters.name: reference
parameters.description: Transaction reference from the checkout onSuccess callback, e.g. KDV-1775413916000 — passed as path parameter

example_prompt: Verify a KadevPay transaction server-side and confirm its status before fulfilling an order.
gotchas: Use the SECRET key (kdvs_*), not the public key — using the wrong key returns 401.
reference is passed as a path parameter: GET /api/v1/transactions/verify/{reference}, not in the request body.

Check both conditions before fulfilling: top-level status === 'success' AND data.status === 'paid'. Checking only data.status is not sufficient — an invalid reference can return a non-success top-level status.

The reference comes from the browser (onSuccess callback or callback_url redirect), so validate it server-side before putting it in the path: a visitor can send "../…" and make this call, with your secret key, reach another endpoint. The docs give no format (only the example KDV-1775413916000), so the example rejects an empty value, ".", "..", and any /, \, ?, #, %, space or control character.
mode: 'test' appears in sandbox responses — check this field to distinguish test vs live transactions.
open_questions: Reference format: the docs only show the example "https://pay.kadev.ci/api/v1/transactions/verify/KDV-1775413916000" — which characters and length can a reference have (e.g. KDV- followed by digits only)? Until then the example applies only a generic path-segment guard.
Sandbox: provider.json says a sandbox exists and responses carry mode: "test", but no sandbox host is documented here — same host with test keys, or another host?
